_comment: Canon base founders (plan §10.2, amended by Zach 30 Aug: the founders are SHARKS, same cast as the five panel sharks in public/sharks/). Every skin renders on both. Generate candidates with `node scripts/generate-briefcase-art.mjs bases`, hand-pick one per base, then crown it with `crown --base <novus|nova> --pick <n>`. The crowned render lands in assets-src/briefcase/canon/ and is attached as a reference image to every subsequent skin generation.
_species: Read from the shipped cast: a chunky cartoon shark standing upright on two stubby legs — two-tone grey (darker top, pale grey-cream belly and snout underside), a tall dorsal fin, a long tail fin sweeping to one side, side fins doubling as arms ending in simple mitt hands, three short gill slits, a wide grin full of neat white teeth, big simple expressive eyes, dark rounded shoes.

novus.name: Novus
novus.description: a friendly cartoon SHARK founder — the exact same shark species, proportions and material as the reference images (chunky upright shark, two-tone grey with a pale cream belly, tall dorsal fin, long sweeping tail fin, side fins as arms with simple mitt hands, three gill slits, dark rounded shoes). Masc styling: broad squared snout, thick confident brow, a wide open grin showing neat white teeth, big simple oval eyes
novus.candidateOutfit: plain heather-grey hoodie with a small orange #FF6B00 drawstring detail, dark jeans, white sneakers

nova.name: Nova
